question: Datacenter Card Specs: A100 80GB: ~2039 GB/s BW, ~$10,000-$15,000 USD [二手/新价波动大]. H100 SXM 80GB: ~3350 GB/s BW, ~$25,000-$30,000 USD. H200 141GB: ~4.8 TB/s BW, ~$30,000+. B200: ~8 TB/s BW, Price TBD. These offer higher bandwidth and capacity but significantly higher CapEx.
